model_update_policy: Decoupled Architecture: Routine software updates NEVER re-download model weights (10 MB app-only download). Existing 4.5 GB neural weights in Zone 3 are preserved permanently unless a breakthrough fine-tune is explicitly flagged.

tier_1_bootstrap.title: Smart Web Installer (Recommended)
